prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this Seldan portrait to remove the ENTIRE dark brown/black backdrop and the diffuse golden glow around his silhouette. Output a clean isolated character cutout on genuine transparent alpha. Keep the character artwork, face, gray hair, armor, hands, pose, sepia colors, stippling and black outlines unchanged. Only the character silhouette should remain visible. No shadow, no halo, no glow, no background pixels or checkerboard. Character interior must be solid opaque, outside must be fully transparent. Preserve all hair strands and shoulder armor edges; do not redraw the design.
verificacao_visual: Recorte inspecionado sobre branco respeitando alfa. O halo da prévia corresponde a RGB em pixels transparentes e não aparece na composição. Alfa original preservado (máximo 254).
